# Captured verbatim from `aapt dump xmltree <apk> AndroidManifest.xml` on a
# real expo-dev-client debug APK (com.th3rdwave 7.0.7, built by rn-iso's own
# gradle path and pulled out of the shared build cache), then TRIMMED to the
# activities that matter: the launchable one, a third-party SDK's deep-link
# interceptor, and expo-dev-launcher's own AuthActivity. Nothing else is
# edited -- the indentation, the `@0x...` unresolved resource reference on
# MainActivity's first VIEW filter, and the attribute spelling are as aapt
# printed them.
#
# The trap this fixture exists for: `expo-dev-launcher` IS a scheme in this
# manifest, and it is the LONGEST one, so picking by length (which is what
# Expo's own CLI does) deep-links into the launcher's OAuth callback
# activity rather than into the app.
